*.text: New Mexico context: the east of the state (Lea, Eddy, Chaves, Roosevelt and Curry counties) is in the Southwest Power Pool and served by Xcel's Southwestern Public Service (SPS). Since the 2026 western expansion the SPP queue also holds Farmington Electric's requests. The rest of the state has no market: PNM, El Paso Electric, Tri-State, Farmington and Los Alamos County each run their own interconnection. The New Mexico Public Regulation Commission regulates PNM, SPS and El Paso Electric; its docket system is PRCe360, and the harvest of its cases is under batches/us-nm/harvest/. Air permits come from three agencies: the New Mexico Environment Department Air Quality Bureau for most of the state (its APMAP record, harvested into scopes/us-nm/work/permits/), the City of Albuquerque Air Quality Program for Bernalillo County (Reeves, Rio Bravo), and EPA Region 9 for the Navajo Nation (NTEC). Local planning records are in batches/us-nm/harvest/local_records.md.

Baseline: Amalia Llano edited about 30 New Mexico rows on November 9 and 10, 2026, with notes tagged ALQ42026. Her values are the starting point. Change one only when a document says otherwise, and name the document. The batch goes onto her review page.

Gas fuel cells are out of scope because they do not burn the gas (Baird 2026-11-17). Project Jupiter's fuel cell plant is not added. Backup diesel or gas engines at any data center, fuel cell sites included, are an add with Backup Power yes when the fleet's summed nameplate reaches 50 MW.

Queue requests to answer, from batches/us-nm/harvest/queues.json: SPP FEUS-1 to FEUS-5 (Farmington Electric gas of 60, 60, 180, 60 and 85 MW at Bloomfield, Kirtland and La Plata, 2026 to 2030); SPP ERAS-2025-014 (234 MW at Hobbs, the SWPP ERAS Hobbs record); SPP GEN-2020-065 (1,003 MW combined cycle in Gaines County, Texas, which is other scope); PNM IA-PNM-2025-20 (172 MW gas at the Reeves substation, 2029); PNM IA-PNM-2001-12 and IA-PNM-2007-12 (Valencia County, operational); PNM IA-PNM-2014-02, IA-PNM-2017-14 and IA-PNM-2020-05 (San Juan County gas with old dates); APS Q610 (250 MW at Four Corners, fuel not given). Read the El Paso Electric queue PDF for newer rows. Answer each under queues in coverage.json.

Leads GEM lacks: Pyramid Generating Station (Tri-State, Hidalgo County, EIA 7975, four 46.5 MW turbines, operating since 2003) is an add on the EIA record plus the NMED permit or a Tri-State page. Data centers to answer: Zenith Volts (Chaves County), Google in Lea County, Meta Los Lunas (Greater Kudu LLC, 22 diesel emergency engines in an NMED notice; sum the nameplate from the permit) and the Santa Teresa sites. Farmington's gas requests may name a new city plant; read the utility board packets.

Resource plans, each read in full including every alternative portfolio: PNM 2026 plan (case 25-00022-UT; a 172 MW gas placeholder), SPS 2026 plan (case 25-00076-UT, filed 2026-10-23) and case 25-00066-UT, approved 2026-05-07 (2,088 MW of gas), El Paso Electric 2025 plan (case 24-00260-UT), Tri-State's plan in Colorado, and Farmington, Los Alamos County and Kit Carson if they publish one. The list is scopes/us-nm/irp_plans.json.

Crusoe Energy Systems Gold State Facility (state air permit 10145M1, public notice https://www.env.nm.gov/public-notices/wp-content/uploads/sites/32/2024/06/Legal-Notice-10145M1.pdf, application https://www.env.nm.gov/public-notices/wp-content/uploads/sites/32/2024/06/A-10145M1-CrusoeGoldState-APA-final-2024-05-24.pdf) runs gas engines that make electricity for computing. The papers give horsepower, not electrical ratings. Find the electrical nameplate of the generator sets (the engine model's genset rating) and the location, and answer whether the site reaches 50 MW. Add it if it does, or with capacity blank if no source gives the rating.
